doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
This Annex forms part of the Employment Terms and governs the
calculation of working time, overtime premia and annual leave accrual for all
Employees engaged under a contract of employment with the Company.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
This Annex is to be read so as to give effect to the Company's
obligations under applicable working time legislation. Where any provision of
this Annex would produce a result less favourable to the Employee than the
statutory minimum, the statutory minimum prevails and this Annex is to be read
as modified accordingly.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text: Headings are for convenience only and do not affect construction.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
"Grade" means the Employee's job grade as recorded in the Company's
human resources system of record at the first day of the Payroll Week in
question.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
"Critical Incident Response" means work performed in response to an
incident classified as Severity 1 under the Company's incident management
standard, during the period from declaration of the incident until its formal
closure.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
"Gazetted Public Holiday" means a day designated as a bank or public
holiday in the Employee's principal place of work.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text: The ordinary working week is 40 hours.

doc_title: Employment Terms — Annex C: Working Time, Overtime and Leave
label: PROSE
text:
The Company may vary this Annex by giving not less than one month's
written notice to affected Employees, save that no variation may reduce an
entitlement already accrued at the date the notice takes effect.

label: PROSE
text:
This Policy governs the reimbursement of expenses properly incurred by
Employees and Contingent Workers in the course of Company business.

label: PROSE
text:
This Policy is not intended to describe every circumstance in which an
expense may be incurred. Where this Policy does not address a circumstance, the
Employee is expected to exercise judgement consistent with the Company's values
and to seek guidance from their line manager before incurring the expense.

label: PROSE
text:
Reimbursement under this Policy does not of itself determine the tax
treatment of a payment. Employees remain responsible for their own personal tax
affairs.

label: PROSE
text:
"City Tier" means the tier assigned to the city in which the
expenditure is incurred, as published in the Finance intranet schedule, being
Tier 1, Tier 2 or Tier 3.

label: PROSE
text:
"Client-Billable Travel" means travel which is recoverable from a
client under the terms of an executed statement of work.

label: PROSE
text:
"Travel Day" means each calendar day, or part of a calendar day, on
which the Employee is away from their principal place of work overnight on
Company business. The day of departure and the day of return are each a Travel
Day.

label: PROSE
text:
"Pre-Approval" means written approval obtained before the expense is
incurred from a person holding delegated financial authority at or above the
threshold of the expense.

label: PROSE
text:
By way of exception to E-3.1 and E-3.2, where Pre-Approval has been
obtained for a specified higher amount, that amount applies.

label: PROSE
text:
No per diem is payable in respect of a Travel Day on which the Employee
does not incur any meal expense.

label: PROSE
text:
The caps in E-4.1 are inclusive of local taxes and of any mandatory
resort or city charge, and exclusive of the cost of parking.

label: PROSE
text: Standard class rail travel is reimbursable at actual cost.

label: HYBRID
text:
By way of exception to E-6.1, a claim submitted after 60 days but
within 120 days may be reimbursed where the Employee's line manager certifies
that the delay was for good reason.

label: PROSE
text:
Nothing in this Policy affects an Employee's entitlements under Annex C
of the Employment Terms.

label: PROSE
text:
The submission of a claim known by the Employee to be false is a
disciplinary matter and may constitute gross misconduct. The Company reserves all
rights in respect of such conduct, including the recovery of sums paid.

label: PROSE
text:
This Plan is discretionary as to its continuation in future years. No
Employee acquires a contractual right to participate in any successor plan.

label: PROSE
text:
Commission is a variable element of remuneration and is not
pensionable.

label: PROSE
text:
"Quota" means the annual revenue target assigned to the Employee in
writing at the start of the Plan Year, or on joining if later.

label: PROSE
text:
"Attainment" means Net Booked Revenue expressed as a percentage of
Quota.

label: PROSE
text:
"Net Booked Revenue" means the aggregate annual contract value of
contracts signed by the Employee during the Plan Year, less the annual contract
value of any Churned Contract.

label: PROSE
text: "Base Commission Rate" means 8.0% of Net Booked Revenue.

label: PROSE
text:
"New Logo" means a customer which had no contract with the Company at
any time in the 24 months preceding the signature date.

label: PROSE
text:
The accelerator determined under S-4.1 applies to the whole of Net
Booked Revenue and not only to the portion above the relevant threshold.

label: PROSE
text:
Where commission has been paid in respect of a contract which
subsequently becomes a Churned Contract, the Company may recover the commission
attributable to that contract by deduction from future commission payments or,
where no such payments fall due, as a debt.

label: PROSE
text:
By way of exception to S-7.1, no recovery will be made where the
contract was terminated by the customer by reason of a material breach by the
Company.

label: PROSE
text:
Any question as to the interpretation or operation of this Plan will be
determined by the Chief Revenue Officer, whose determination is final. This
paragraph does not exclude any statutory right of the Employee.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
This Schedule forms part of the Agreement. Capitalised terms not
defined in this Schedule have the meaning given in clause 1 of the Agreement.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
The Service Credits are the Customer's sole financial remedy for a
failure to meet a Service Level, save in respect of a failure which constitutes a
material breach of the Agreement giving rise to a right of termination.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
The parties acknowledge that the Service Credits represent a genuine
pre-estimate of the loss which the Customer would suffer.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text: "Measurement Period" means each calendar month.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
"Available" means the Service responds to a well-formed request at the
Service's documented endpoint within the applicable latency threshold.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
"Unavailable Minutes" means each whole minute during which the Service
is not Available, excluding Excluded Minutes.

doc_title: Master Services Agreement — Schedule 4: Service Levels and Service Credits
label: PROSE
text:
"Monthly Service Charge" means the charges payable by the Customer in
respect of the Service for the Measurement Period in question, excluding
one-off charges, professional services charges and pass-through charges.

label: PROSE
text:
This Agreement is made between the Company and the Counterparty for the
purpose of permitting each party to evaluate a potential commercial relationship
(the "Permitted Purpose").

label: PROSE
text:
Each party may act as Discloser in respect of information it discloses
and as Recipient in respect of information disclosed to it.

label: PROSE
text:
"Confidential Information" means all information disclosed by or on
behalf of the Discloser to the Recipient, whether before or after the date of
this Agreement, whether in writing, orally or by inspection of tangible objects,
which is designated as confidential or which by its nature or the circumstances
of its disclosure ought reasonably to be regarded as confidential.

label: PROSE
text:
Confidential Information includes the existence and contents of this
Agreement and the fact that the parties are in discussions.

label: PROSE
text:
Confidential Information does not include information which:

  (a) is or becomes generally available to the public other than as a result of a
      breach of this Agreement by the Recipient;
  (b) was lawfully in the Recipient's possession without obligation of
      confidence before disclosure by the Discloser;
  (c) is lawfully obtained by the Recipient from a third party who is not under
      an obligation of confidence in respect of it; or
  (d) is independently developed by the Recipient without use of or reference to
      the Confidential Information.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient will keep the Confidential Information confidential and
will not disclose it to any person except as permitted by this Agreement.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient will use the Confidential Information solely for the
Permitted Purpose.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient will protect the Confidential Information using no less
than the degree of care it applies to its own confidential information of like
importance, and in any event no less than a reasonable degree of care.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to those of its
officers, employees, professional advisers and group companies who need to know
it for the Permitted Purpose, provided that the Recipient ensures each such
person is bound by obligations of confidence no less onerous than those in this
Agreement and remains liable for any breach by them.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient may disclose Confidential Information to the extent
required by law, by a court of competent jurisdiction or by a regulatory
authority, provided that, to the extent lawful and practicable, the Recipient
gives the Discloser prior written notice sufficient to allow the Discloser to
seek protective measures.

label: PROSE
text:
By way of exception to N-5.2, the obligations of confidence in respect
of Confidential Information which constitutes a trade secret continue for so long
as that information remains a trade secret.

label: PROSE
text:
By way of exception to N-5.2, the obligations of confidence in respect
of personal data continue for so long as the Recipient holds that personal data.

label: PROSE
text:
On the written request of the Discloser, the Recipient will promptly
return or destroy all Confidential Information in its possession and, if
requested, certify in writing that it has done so.

label: PROSE
text:
The Recipient may retain one copy of the Confidential Information to
the extent required by law or by its internal record-keeping or backup policies,
provided that the retained copy remains subject to this Agreement.

label: PROSE
text:
No licence of any intellectual property right is granted by this
Agreement.

label: PROSE
text:
The Confidential Information is provided "as is". The Discloser gives no
warranty as to its accuracy or completeness.

label: PROSE
text:
Each party acknowledges that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy
for a breach of this Agreement and that the Discloser is entitled to seek
injunctive relief in addition to any other remedy.

label: PROSE
text:
This Agreement is governed by the law of England and Wales and the
parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales.

label: PROSE
text:
No variation of this Agreement is effective unless in writing and signed
by both parties.

label: PROSE
text:
This Agreement does not create any partnership, agency or joint venture
between the parties, and neither party is obliged to enter into any further
agreement.

label: PROSE
text:
This Standard specifies the periods for which the Company retains
records and the basis on which records are deleted. It applies to all records
held by the Company in any form.

label: PROSE
text:
Retention is a balance between the Company's legitimate need to hold
information and the principle that personal data must not be kept longer than is
necessary. Where this Standard specifies a maximum period, business units are
expected to delete earlier where the purpose for which the record was collected
has been achieved.

label: PROSE
text:
"Data Class" means the classification assigned to a record under the
Company's information classification policy, being one of: Employee Record,
Customer Contract, Financial Record, Marketing Contact, Security Log, or
Candidate Record.

label: PROSE
text:
"Retention Trigger" means the event from which the retention period is
measured, as specified in R-3.

label: PROSE
text:
"Legal Hold" means a documented instruction issued by the General
Counsel or their delegate to preserve specified records in connection with
actual or reasonably anticipated litigation, investigation or regulatory
proceedings.

label: PROSE
text:
"Deletion" means the destruction of a record such that it cannot be
reconstructed by ordinary means, including deletion from backups at the
expiry of the backup rotation cycle.

label: PROSE
text:
Notwithstanding R-3, a record subject to a Legal Hold must not be
deleted while the Legal Hold remains in force, irrespective of the expiry of the
applicable retention period.

label: PROSE
text:
A Legal Hold takes precedence over any request for erasure made by a
data subject, to the extent permitted by applicable data protection law.

label: PROSE
text:
By way of exception to R-5.1, the Company will not delete personal data
where it is required to retain it to comply with a legal obligation, for the
establishment or exercise of legal claims, or where a Legal Hold applies.

label: PROSE
text:
Each business unit is accountable for applying this Standard to the
records it holds. The Privacy Office maintains the record of processing and
reviews compliance annually.

label: PROSE
text:
Any departure from this Standard requires the written approval of the
Privacy Office and is recorded in the exceptions register.
